title: Demon Slayer Drops Cute New Look at the Coolest Hashira Ahead of Infinity Castle Part 2
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba fans are still waiting on the next Infinity Castle movie , but the franchise has dropped a cute new look at the Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, to help celebrate his birthday in the meantime.
author: ComicBook

title: Seth MacFarlane & American Dad Honor Patrick Stewart With Tribute: “Deeply Missed By the Entire Planet”
content: Legendary star of stage and screen Patrick Stewart has sadly passed away at the age of 86 this week , and American Dad! and franchise creator Seth MacFarlane have shared emotional tributes to the star thanks to all of the work he’s done across MacFarlane’s works like American Dad!, Family Guy, Ted and more.
author: ComicBook

title: DC Studios’ New Green Lantern Animated Series Confirms Episode Count With Promising Update
content: Warner Bros. Animation and DC Studios are now in the works on a new animated series set in the same universe as My Adventures with Superman , and Peter Safran has shared a promising update on how it’s all coming along with a confirmation of how long it’s debut outing is going to be.
author: ComicBook

title: Romelia War Chronicle Anime's 2nd Part Unveils April 2027 Debut, Ending Song's Artist
content: The staff of the television anime of Ryō Ariyama 's Romelia War Chronicle: Even After Defeating the Demon King, Humanity Still Seems Doomed, So I Formed a Military Force ( Romelia Senki: Maō o Taoshita Ato mo Jinrui Yabasō Dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita ) light novel series announced the April 2027 television premiere…
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms It’s Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes With Perfect Score After Finale
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has officially wrapped up its debut season with Paramount+, and the series has been Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes with a rare perfect score among critics.
author: ComicBook

title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love Anime Reveals New Trailer, Opening Theme Song Artist
content: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love anime revealed a new trailer and the opening theme song artist on Saturday. Cosplayer Enako will sing the opening theme song and will also voice the character Nene Haneshita. The series is slated to premiere in January 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Hiragi-san's House of Vampires Gets Anime
content: Hiragi-san’s House of Vampires manga by Miki Yoshikawa ( A Couple of Cuckoos ) is getting a TV anime adaptation by TMS’s Unlimited Produce. A visual was also unveiled: Yoshikawa initially launched the series as a one-shot in Kodansha’s shonen manga magazine Weekly Shonen Magazine in 2019.
author: Anime Corner

title: Comisma, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank Establish Anime Production Fund
content: COMISMA stated the fund will enhance financial support for creators and "offer new investment opportunities to investors who have previously had little access to the anime production business." COMISMA and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank will jointly establish and operate the fund.
author: ANN

title: Cosplayer Enako Sings, Voice-Acts in Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love Anime
content: Kadokawa presented the full promotional video for the television anime of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love ( Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai ) manga on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Supporting Cast for 'Kaze wo Tsugumono' Announced
content: The official website for the Kaze wo Tsugumono ( Inherit the Winds ) original television anime announced supporting cast on Saturday. An advance theatrical screening will run for two weeks starting November 13. The anime will premiere in January 2027 at 11:30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList
